notes: We know why we exist and how we behave. Now: how far do we want to go, and what does the next three years look like?

slides.title: BHAG: Big Hairy Audacious Goal
slides.headline: BHAG: Big Hairy Audacious Goal
notes: BHAG: Big Hairy Audacious Goal (Jim Collins).
It should need the company to grow well beyond what it can do today.
The 3HAG carries the numbers. The BHAG carries the ambition.
slides.support: Your company’s ambition for the next 10 to 30 years.
body: Words only. No numbers, no dates.

artwork.alt: Three people look up at a huge mountain rising above the clouds, a green flag at its summit.

slides.title: BHAGs that worked.
slides.headline: BHAGs that worked.
notes: None has a number or a date. Each one you can picture.
Ask: which one would you get out of bed for? Why?
Historical statements, not current company goals.

panels.heading: “A computer on every desk and in every home.”

slides.title: What is your BHAG?
slides.headline: What is your BHAG?
notes: Everyone writes before anyone reads theirs out.
No numbers, no dates. Wrong but aligned beats no BHAG.
body: Share, discuss, then agree on a good-enough version.

artwork.alt: The BHAG mountain with its summit flag. Beside the flag: BHAG. Write it in one sentence. Share, discuss, then agree on a good-enough version.

slides.title: Is the ambition clear, connected and exciting?
slides.headline: Is the ambition clear, connected and exciting?
notes: Use Jim Collins’s tests as presented in Shannon’s source. Distinguish the 10 to 30 year horizon from this specific 25-year test.
Test leader enthusiasm separately from wider-team enthusiasm.
Do not accept an ambition that only repeats today’s business at a larger scale without meaningful stretch.
At a quarterly, change only what fails or is no longer true.

panels.heading: Connected to purpose?
panels.support: Does it express why you exist?

panels.heading: Can we recognize success?
panels.support: Could you tell whether you had achieved it in 25 years?

panels.heading: Exciting to you?
panels.support: Does it create energy among the leaders?

panels.heading: Exciting to the wider team?
panels.support: Would others want to pursue it?

panels.heading: A big step in capability?
panels.support: What would you need to become able to do?
